title: Caillettes
ingredients: 150g cooked long-grain rice made from 65g (1/3 cup) uncooked rice
250g baby spinach, blanched, refreshed, squeezed dry, chopped
1 tablespoon each chopped basil and flat-leaf parsley
125ml (1/2 cup) extra virgin olive oil, plus extra, to cook
For sauce tomate and bagna rotou, combine ingredients in 2 bowls. Season.
directions: For caillettes, combine all ingredients, except fat, in a bowl. Season. Shape mixture into 20 x 10cm logs. Cut caul into 20 x 20cm-long pieces, place logs at one end and roll caul over once. Fold in sides, then roll to enclose. Or, make like flattened meatballs.
Heat a chargrill pan or barbecue over medium heat and cook caillettes, in batches, for 5 minutes each side or until cooked through. Serve with the sauces.
